Here's your voat IRC, maybe not the official one, but one with many of voats well known posters and moderators. Initially, having seen what went on in the redditsphere, I had some negative feelings about the IRC. Unfortunately these were pre-conceived notions and assumptions that I would not have made had I taken the chance to chat there.

The issue right now on voat is a symptom of paranoia and distrust coming over from some of our experiences on reddit. While some people here have come over with opinions or stances matching what a lot of you would consider the enemy at voat, they have not come over here to unjustly rule or disease the site as many, myself included initially believed.

There have been hiccups, and there will be debate on rules, and that sort of thing is because voat is young, but also because voat allows that type of debate. We aren't awaiting new announcements wondering which subverses may be quarantined, and we aren't shut off from direct communication with the 2 founders on the site. For every negative you can find I can find dozens of positives here on voat that you wont find elsewhere.

We're being given a chance as a community to actually mold the site to our tastes, but in order for everyone to be happy we have to be able to constructively debate and develop rule sets and ideas that help the site. Initially I identified some people to myself who I'd come to believe wanted to harm the site, and after having discussions with most of them, I've come to the conclusion that it wasn't corrupt power hungry people I was talking to, just passionate people like myself with different worldviews.

Often on reddit I would go back and forth with people through maybe dozens of comments, it would often lead to me being called a troll, or the other being a troll. That label removes the importance of that type of back and forth. One beautiful thing about the internet is people can make a point, or ask a question they may not in person. Some find ways to make this vile, for the lels, and some find a way to pursue discourse with this.

Right now voat is full of a bunch of different ideas, types of people, and concepts for making voat awesome, so don't be quick like me to judge and label and witch hunt people.

Another thing I should mention, upon entry to the IRC, with my own name, I was welcomed and treated no differently than anyone else. Everyone who wasn't spamming was given a voice there. I think it helped me to identify people across the threads as people, instead of some mysterious enemy. I'd advise you all to bear in mind, while we don't want voat taken over by any set of biased ideals, we have no real fear of that happening. We have the same amount of voice here as any moderator, the admins have not handed mods that level of control, and as it appears, they wont.
